articles.title: 少年与英语
articles.description: 一个准备离家的少年，一次改变他的谈话。

lessons.title: 离家前的决定
lessons.subtitle: A suitcase full of worries
lessons.prompt: 一个少年正在收拾行李。是什么让他决定离开？

paragraphs.en: A teenager hid behind loose, dusty curtains, packing his overcoat into a suitcase.
paragraphs.zh: 一个少年躲在松垮、积满灰尘的窗帘后，把大衣装进行李箱。

paragraphs.en: He planned to leave home at dusk, even though there was thunder and lightning outside.
paragraphs.zh: 他计划在黄昏时离家，尽管外面雷电交加。

paragraphs.en: He had to do this because he was fed up with his parents’ nagging about his English learning and couldn’t bear it any longer.
paragraphs.zh: 他觉得自己必须这样做，因为他已经厌烦父母对英语学习的唠叨，再也无法忍受了。

questions.prompt: When did the teenager plan to leave?
questions.explanation: at dusk 意为“在黄昏时”。留意 planned to：这是他的计划，文章还没有说他已经离开。
questions.promptZh: 少年计划什么时候离开？

questions.prompt: Why did he want to leave home?
options: He wanted to buy a coat.
He could no longer bear the nagging.
questions.answer: He could no longer bear the nagging.
questions.explanation: fed up with 和 couldn’t bear … any longer 都表达了他对唠叨的厌烦与难以忍受。

practice.prompt: He hid behind loose, ___ curtains.
practice.explanation: dust（灰尘）＋ -y → dusty，表示“布满灰尘的”。

practice.prompt: He hid behind loose, dusty ___.
practice.explanation: 文中 curtains 用复数，指窗帘。填空时留意单复数。
practice.promptZh: 他躲在松垮、积满灰尘的___后。

practice.prompt: He was ___ his overcoat into a suitcase.
practice.explanation: 文中的 packing 表示与 hid 同时发生的动作；need to 后接原形 pack。
practice.promptZh: 他正在把大衣___进行李箱。

practice.prompt: He packed his overcoat into a ___.
practice.explanation: 用“衣物放进旅行用的箱子”这一场景理解 suitcase。

practice.prompt: He planned to leave home at ___.
practice.explanation: dusk 是日落后天色渐暗的时候；固定搭配 at dusk。

practice.prompt: He couldn’t ___ it any longer.
practice.explanation: 这里 bear 是动词“忍受”，不是名词“熊”。couldn’t 后用原形。

practice.prompt: The old books were covered in dust. They were ___.
practice.explanation: dust（灰尘）＋ -y → dusty，表示“布满灰尘的”。
practice.promptZh: 旧书上盖满了灰尘。它们___。

practice.prompt: Please close the ___ to keep the light out.
practice.explanation: 文中 curtains 用复数，指窗帘。填空时留意单复数。

practice.prompt: We need to ___ our bags before the trip.
practice.explanation: 文中的 packing 表示与 hid 同时发生的动作；need to 后接原形 pack。

practice.prompt: She put her clothes in a ___ for the holiday.
practice.explanation: 用“衣物放进旅行用的箱子”这一场景理解 suitcase。
practice.promptZh: 她把度假要穿的衣服放进一个___。

practice.prompt: The sun was setting. We arrived at ___.
practice.explanation: dusk 是日落后天色渐暗的时候；固定搭配 at dusk。
practice.promptZh: 太阳正在落山。我们在___到达。

practice.prompt: The noise is so loud that I cannot ___ it.
practice.explanation: 这里 bear 是动词“忍受”，不是名词“熊”。couldn’t 后用原形。

lessons.title: 朋友的倾听
lessons.subtitle: Someone who understands
lessons.prompt: 朋友理解他的处境，却不赞成他的决定。她会怎样帮助他？

paragraphs.en: He wasn’t good at English and didn’t like attending English classes because he felt the teacher ignored him.
paragraphs.zh: 他不擅长英语，也不喜欢上英语课，因为他觉得老师忽视了他。

paragraphs.en: His partner was very worried about him. She fully understood what he was going through but completely disagreed with his idea.
paragraphs.zh: 他的搭档非常担心他。她完全理解他正在经历的事，却完全不赞同他的想法。

paragraphs.en: To calm him down and solve his problem, she talked with him face to face and shared a series of tips on learning English with him.
paragraphs.zh: 为了让他平静下来并解决问题，她与他面对面交谈，分享了一系列学习英语的建议。

questions.prompt: How did his partner feel about his plan?
options: She wanted to leave with him.
questions.explanation: understood … but … disagreed：理解一个人的感受，不等于赞同他的做法。
questions.promptZh: 他的搭档怎么看待他的计划？

questions.prompt: What did she do to help?
options: She talked with him and shared tips.
She asked him to stop studying.
questions.answer: She talked with him and shared tips.
questions.explanation: 她通过 face to face 的谈话和 a series of tips 来帮助他。
optionTranslations: 她和他交谈，并分享建议。

practice.prompt: He felt the teacher ___ him.
practice.explanation: ignored 是过去式。注意文中是“他觉得”老师忽视了他。

practice.prompt: She understood what he was ___.
practice.explanation: 本句表示“经历”，不是从某个物体中穿过。

practice.prompt: She completely ___ with his idea.
practice.explanation: dis- ＋ agree（同意）→ disagree；常与 with 连用。

practice.prompt: She wanted to ___ him down.
practice.explanation: calm him down：代词 him 放在 calm 和 down 中间。

practice.prompt: She talked with him ___.
practice.explanation: 在 talked 后说明交谈方式，用 face to face。

practice.prompt: She shared a ___ of tips with him.
practice.explanation: a series of 后接复数名词；series 的单复数形式相同。

practice.prompt: Please do not ___ someone who asks for help.
practice.explanation: ignored 是过去式。注意文中是“他觉得”老师忽视了他。

practice.prompt: Many students ___ a difficult time before exams.
practice.explanation: 本句表示“经历”，不是从某个物体中穿过。
practice.promptZh: 许多学生在考试前会___一段困难时期。

practice.prompt: I understand your idea, but I ___ with it.
practice.explanation: dis- ＋ agree（同意）→ disagree；常与 with 连用。
practice.promptZh: 我理解你的想法，但我___它。

practice.prompt: Take a slow breath to ___ yourself down.
practice.explanation: calm him down：代词 him 放在 calm 和 down 中间。
practice.promptZh: 缓缓吸一口气，让自己___下来。

practice.prompt: Let’s meet and discuss this ___ instead of texting.
practice.explanation: 在 talked 后说明交谈方式，用 face to face。
practice.promptZh: 我们见面___讨论这件事吧，不要发短信了。

practice.prompt: The teacher asked a ___ of questions.
practice.explanation: a series of 后接复数名词；series 的单复数形式相同。

lessons.title: 找回学习的力量
lessons.subtitle: A different way forward
lessons.prompt: 一次谈话之后，他开始重新看待英语学习。读一读故事的结尾。

paragraphs.en: The learning methods she wrote down helped him find the “path” to learning English well.
paragraphs.zh: 她写下的学习方法，帮助他找到了学好英语的“道路”。

paragraphs.en: The teenager was very grateful and gained great strength from his friend’s words.
paragraphs.zh: 少年非常感激，并从朋友的话中获得了很大的力量。

paragraphs.en: Now, he has recovered from his depression and fallen in love with English.
paragraphs.zh: 现在，他已经从低落的情绪中恢复过来，并爱上了英语。

questions.prompt: What helped him find a path to learning English?
questions.explanation: The learning methods … helped him：主语是“学习方法”，she wrote down 补充说明这些方法是谁写下的。
questions.promptZh: 什么帮助他找到了学习英语的方法？

questions.prompt: What changed by the end of the story?
options: He stopped talking to his friend.
He left home in the storm.
questions.explanation: fallen in love with English 表示他已经喜欢上了英语。文中没有说他最终离家了。
questions.promptZh: 故事结束时发生了什么变化？

practice.prompt: The learning ___ helped him find a path.
practice.explanation: 原文 methods 是复数；新句前有 a，所以用单数 method。
practice.promptZh: 这些学习___帮助他找到了方向。

practice.prompt: The teenager was very ___.
practice.explanation: be grateful to 人 for 事：因某事而感激某人。

practice.prompt: He ___ great strength from his friend’s words.
practice.explanation: gain 常用于获得经验、信心、力量等。
practice.promptZh: 他从朋友的话中___了很大的力量。

practice.prompt: He gained great ___ from his friend’s words.
practice.explanation: 本句偏重精神上的力量；strong 的名词形式是 strength。
practice.promptZh: 他从朋友的话中获得了很大的___。

practice.prompt: He has ___ from his depression.
practice.explanation: 原文 has recovered 是现在完成时；新句 to 后用原形。
practice.promptZh: 他已经从低落的情绪中___过来。

practice.prompt: He has ___ English.
practice.explanation: fall → fell → fallen；原文 has 后用过去分词 fallen。

practice.prompt: Reading aloud is a useful ___ for learning English.
practice.explanation: 原文 methods 是复数；新句前有 a，所以用单数 method。
practice.promptZh: 朗读是学习英语的一种实用___。

practice.prompt: I am ___ to you for your help.
practice.explanation: be grateful to 人 for 事：因某事而感激某人。

practice.prompt: You can ___ experience by trying new things.
practice.explanation: gain 常用于获得经验、信心、力量等。
practice.promptZh: 尝试新事物能让你___经验。

practice.prompt: Her kind words gave me the ___ to try again.
practice.explanation: 本句偏重精神上的力量；strong 的名词形式是 strength。
practice.promptZh: 她温暖的话语给了我再次尝试的___。

practice.prompt: It takes time to ___ from a bad cold.
practice.explanation: 原文 has recovered 是现在完成时；新句 to 后用原形。

practice.prompt: Visit this city and you may ___ its beautiful parks.
practice.explanation: fall → fell → fallen；原文 has 后用过去分词 fallen。
practice.promptZh: 来这座城市看看，你可能会___这里美丽的公园。

dictionary.example: He planned to leave home at dusk.

dictionary.transfer: The noise is so loud that I cannot ___ it.
dictionary.note: 这里 bear 是动词“忍受”，不是名词“熊”。couldn’t 后用原形。
dictionary.example: He couldn’t bear it any longer.

dictionary.transfer: Please do not ___ someone who asks for help.
dictionary.note: ignored 是过去式。注意文中是“他觉得”老师忽视了他。
dictionary.example: He felt the teacher ignored him.

dictionary.collocation: go through a difficult time · 经历困难时期
dictionary.transfer: Many students ___ a difficult time before exams.
dictionary.note: 本句表示“经历”，不是从某个物体中穿过。
dictionary.example: She understood what he was going through.

dictionary.collocation: disagree with an idea · 不赞同一个想法
dictionary.transfer: I understand your idea, but I ___ with it.
dictionary.note: dis- ＋ agree（同意）→ disagree；常与 with 连用。
dictionary.example: She completely disagreed with his idea.

dictionary.collocation: calm someone down · 使某人平静下来
dictionary.transfer: Take a slow breath to ___ yourself down.
dictionary.note: calm him down：代词 him 放在 calm 和 down 中间。
dictionary.example: She wanted to calm him down.

dictionary.collocation: talk face to face · 面对面交谈
dictionary.transfer: Let’s meet and discuss this ___ instead of texting.
dictionary.note: 在 talked 后说明交谈方式，用 face to face。
dictionary.example: She talked with him face to face.

dictionary.collocation: a series of tips · 一系列建议
dictionary.original: She shared a ___ of tips with him.
dictionary.transfer: The teacher asked a ___ of questions.
dictionary.note: a series of 后接复数名词；series 的单复数形式相同。
dictionary.example: She shared a series of tips with him.

dictionary.original: The learning ___ helped him find a path.
dictionary.transfer: Reading aloud is a useful ___ for learning English.
dictionary.note: 原文 methods 是复数；新句前有 a，所以用单数 method。
dictionary.example: The learning methods helped him find a path.

dictionary.collocation: be grateful to someone · 感激某人
dictionary.transfer: I am ___ to you for your help.
dictionary.note: be grateful to 人 for 事：因某事而感激某人。
dictionary.example: The teenager was very grateful.

dictionary.original: He ___ great strength from his friend’s words.
dictionary.transfer: You can ___ experience by trying new things.
dictionary.note: gain 常用于获得经验、信心、力量等。
dictionary.example: He gained great strength from his friend’s words.

dictionary.collocation: gain strength from … · 从……获得力量
dictionary.original: He gained great ___ from his friend’s words.
dictionary.transfer: Her kind words gave me the ___ to try again.
dictionary.note: 本句偏重精神上的力量；strong 的名词形式是 strength。
dictionary.example: He gained great strength from his friend’s words.

dictionary.transfer: It takes time to ___ from a bad cold.
dictionary.note: 原文 has recovered 是现在完成时；新句 to 后用原形。
dictionary.example: He has recovered from his depression.

dictionary.collocation: fall in love with English · 爱上英语
dictionary.transfer: Visit this city and you may ___ its beautiful parks.
dictionary.note: fall → fell → fallen；原文 has 后用过去分词 fallen。
